SUBHADIP BOSE Senior Project Manager | Program Manager | Technical Project Manager

Pune, Maharashtra • +919830340616 • subhadipbose1984@gmail.com LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/subhadip-bose-69938965

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Seasoned Project & Program Manager with 19+ years of experience leading banking, financial services, insurance, and enterprise IT transformation programs across Retail and Commercial operations. Combines strong functional/business delivery leadership with deep technical grounding in IT operations, cybersecurity, patch governance, and automation — a rare blend of strategic business acumen and hands-on technical credibility.

Proven track record of leading enterprise-wide digital transformation, cyber remediation, and automation (RPA/AI) initiatives, improving service delivery, strengthening governance, and driving measurable business outcomes through Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models.

Recognized for strong people leadership, stakeholder management, and executive communication, with the ability to translate business strategy and cyber/risk objectives into structured, actionable delivery roadmaps. Extensive experience partnering with business leaders, operations, compliance, security, and vendors to modernize processes, enhance customer experience, and improve operational efficiency.

Strong client handling, strategic planning, escalation management, and consistent delivery on time and within budget while maintaining high customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance.

Core strengths: end-to-end project/program governance, Agile & hybrid execution, change management, IT operations & cybersecurity leadership, and delivery assurance in regulated banking and financial environments.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Project Management • Program Management • Agile, Waterfall & Hybrid Delivery • Project Governance • PMO Processes • Stakeholder & Executive Communication • Risk & Compliance • Business Analysis • Change & Adoption Management • Automation Projects (RPA/AI) • Cryptography & PKI Management • Patch & Release Governance • IT Operations Leadership • Vendor & Team Management • SDLC • Incident/Problem/Change Management (ITIL) • Cloud (GCP) • SQL • Cybersecurity (TPAM) • DR & BCM • Performance Reporting (MI/BI) • JIRA & Confluence

Business Transformation & Change Leadership

Lead complex, multi-stream change programs across business units with clear ownership of outcomes, benefits, and adoption. • Partner with senior business leaders to shape priorities, influence decisions, and manage expectations across the change lifecycle — including Digital Transformation across Retail & Commercial Banking.

Value-Driven Delivery & Benefits Realisation

Strong focus on solving business problems, improving processes, and delivering measurable outcomes (cost reduction, efficiency, risk reduction, customer experience).

Track benefits, risks, and dependencies to ensure delivery answers the “so what” for the business.

Governance, Risk & Assurance

Establish and run robust governance frameworks with transparent reporting, SteerCo engagement, and regulatory alignment. • Proactively identify, manage, and mitigate risks/issues to avoid business disruption and protect outcomes.

IT Operations, Cybersecurity & Patch Governance

Drive vulnerability remediation programs (patching, configuration fixes, control gap closure); translate cyber risk and control objectives into actionable delivery plans, test strategies, and measurable outcomes.

Strong background in patch governance, audit compliance, and cybersecurity operations, with hands-on experience in SCCM, JIRA, ServiceNow, and enterprise reporting tools.

Agile & Hybrid Execution

Deep expertise in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery models to enable faster value realisation and continuous improvement, while balancing pace with control in regulated environments.

Stakeholder, Vendor & Team Leadership

• Coordinate cross-functional teams, foster accountability, and enable high performance across business, operations, technology,

and partners.

• Strong commercial acumen and senior-level communication and influencing skills.

Behavioural Strengths

Customer-centric, outcome-focused mindset • Strategic, enterprise-level thinking • Resilient and effective in ambiguity and high-pressure environments

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Clarien Bank — Project Manager – Project and Change Management Pune, India

July 2025 – Present

Leading a multi-phase digital transformation program focused on improving service delivery and operational effectiveness across Retail and Commercial Banking operations, using Agile and Scrum methodologies for onshore technology delivery.

Driving a comprehensive transformation initiative addressing operational inefficiencies through process optimization, workflow automation, and improved digital collaboration.

Established robust project governance, including delivery KPIs, risk & issue management, dependency tracking, monthly governance reporting, incident/change trends, and release readiness.

Own end-to-end project delivery from initiation to benefits realization; lead cross-functional business, operations, delivery, QA, platform, and support teams.

Facilitate SteerCo updates, Quarterly Business Reviews, and strategic roadmap discussions; manage escalations ensuring SLA adherence and quality triage.

Embedded security and control objectives into SDLC and release lifecycle, ensuring secure design and deployment; strengthened CI/CD quality gates and validation processes.

Partnered with business heads, operations, compliance, and vendors to align transformation outcomes with regulatory and customer experience objectives; drove change adoption, release readiness, and business transition planning. Business Outcome: Delivered measurable operational improvements through end-to-end transformation: ~70% reduction in service cycle times, ~40% reduction in manual errors, and material reduction in manual workload across operations.

Majesco — Project Manager Pune, India

Mar 2024 – July 2025

Led large-scale Agile transformation initiatives for global financial services and insurance clients, focusing on modernizing business processes, improving service responsiveness, and enhancing customer experience.

Delivered end-to-end transformation programs using Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid models across a 100% client-facing portfolio, ensuring alignment of product capabilities to customer business processes.

Acted as primary engagement lead for client stakeholders, ensuring alignment between business priorities and delivery outcomes.

Implemented structured governance covering delivery metrics, risks, dependencies, release readiness, and SNOW incident/escalation management with SLA adherence and quality triage.

Directed incident, change, problem, and patch governance processes; conducted Quarterly Business Reviews, case reviews, and strategic roadmap sessions.

Embedded security and control objectives into SDLC and release lifecycle; partnered with QA and Dev teams to improve test coverage, defect leakage, and release quality; introduced metrics-driven governance (defect escape rate, release readiness, SLA adherence). Business Outcome: Enabled 30% improvement in delivery turnaround times, reduced delivery-related escalations by ~25% through standardized governance, and improved customer experience and operational responsiveness across Banking and Insurance functions.

Rabbit & Tortoise Technology Solutions (RNT) — Project Manager / Technical Project Manager Nov 2022 – Mar 2024 Led multiple onshore automation initiatives using Agile & Waterfall frameworks, directing automation (RPA/AI) projects from planning through deployment.

Built and led high-performance cross-functional teams to deliver complex automation implementations; developed comprehensive project plans, budgets, resource allocations, and risk plans.

Standardized project documentation, delivery practices, and client communication workflows; drove quality assurance for automation deliverables and process improvements to maximize ROI and adoption. Business Outcome: Delivered automation initiatives resulting in 30–50% reduction in manual processing effort, 20–35% productivity uplik, and ~25% reduction in rework/exceptions — directly improving ROI from automation investments.

Integrated Resources Inc. — Global Project Manager Owned the global IT landscape including network, security, IT infrastructure, and applications.

Jun 2022 – Nov 2022

Led organization-wide IT transformation and infrastructure modernization; directed network engineering, cybersecurity, policy development, and governance.

Led enterprise cybersecurity and infrastructure transformation, including vulnerability assessments, access control, and risk remediation programs; defined security policies, control frameworks, and audit-readiness processes.

Managed servers, firewalls, security tools, routing/switching, asset management, and user access; standardized IT processes, risk assessments, DR, and vulnerability assessments.

Managed global vendors, contracts, and technology procurement. Leadership areas: Program Governance, IT Security & Risk Management, Technology Roadmapping, Team Leadership & Coaching. Business Outcome: Reduced operational and security risk by ~40% through structured remediation and governance, and improved cost efficiency/vendor performance delivering ~15–20% savings through better commercial oversight.

HSBC — Assistant Vice President / Project Manager (Multiple Roles) Led business consulting, governance, and change initiatives in highly regulated environments alongside enterprise-wide cyber remediation for Windows infrastructure — consistently focusing on business outcomes, risk reduction, and operational efficiency.

Aug 2014 – Jun 2022

Led enterprise-wide cyber remediation program managing vulnerability patching, compliance gaps, and risk mitigation; translated cybersecurity control requirements and audit findings into remediation workstreams within defined SLAs.

Established a risk-based prioritization model for vulnerability remediation across the global estate; integrated security controls into release and deployment cycles with regression and compliance validation.

Developed executive dashboards (SLA compliance, patch coverage, risk exposure, audit findings) for senior stakeholders; collaborated with Cyber Risk, Audit, Infrastructure, and Release teams to drive control effectiveness. ‣ Assistant Vice President – Business Consulting (COO Analytics): delivered reporting, analytics, BI dashboards & governance MI for COO Global Analytics; led automation & standardization of large-scale reporting; managed stakeholders including CROs, COOs & senior global executives.

Project Manager – Patch Governance & Reporting: directed global patching operations for Windows systems across the HSBC estate; prepared SCCM patching reports and provided 24x7 governance support for patch issues, audits, and compliance gaps.

Senior Technical Analyst – Global IT (L2): delivered incident management, network/system administration & desktop operations; worked with global teams on first-time-fix improvements, BAU resolution, and migration support.

Verint System Administrator (Witness Administrator): managed Verint/Witness servers, reporting, and quality monitoring integrated with telecom systems for voice recording and compliance.

Business Outcome: Achieved >98% patch compliance across global estates, reduced manual MI preparation effort by ~50% across global COO analytics teams, and materially reduced audit findings, operational risk, and repeat incidents.

IKF Technologies Ltd. — Lead – Network & System Integration (IT)

Aug 2010 – Aug 2014

Led a 20-member IT operations team managing networks, servers, dialers, voice infrastructure, and desktop operations for 1000+ systems.

HCL Technologies Ltd. — Technical Support Engineer (PSTN/TDM)

Jun 2007 – Aug 2010

Provided technical support for PSTN/TDM processes, IT operations, user support, and telecom applications.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) – Information Technology, JIS College of Engineering, WBUT • 2007 • 76.4%

CERTIFICATIONS & TRAINING

CCNA – Cisco Certified Network Associate • MCSE – Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer • CSM – Certified Scrum Master • PMP – Project Management Professional • Artificial Intelligence Trained: Claude , Emergent, Copilot, Gamma, ChatGPT

TECHNICAL SKILLS

• Project Tools: JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, MS Project

Tech & Platforms: SCCM, SQL, MS Access, GCP Data Studio, Verint, Microsoft CA, Venafi, DigiCert • Networking: Routing, Switching, VLAN, Firewalls, Cisco / Avaya / Nortel • System Administration: Windows, Servers, Monitoring Tools (MRTG/PRTG) • Reporting: Advanced Excel, Dashboards, MI/BI Reporting • Cybersecurity: HSM, KMS, PKI, AES, RSA, TLS 1.2/1.3, TPAM, Audit & Compliance

ACHIEVEMENTS

Multiple Awards for outstanding performance (HSBC). • Recognized with Certificate of Appreciation (IKF Technologies). • Led several large-scale project migrations, cryptography rollouts & patching initiatives.

PERSONAL DETAILS

Languages: English, Hindi, Bengali

Location Preference: Pune / Open to Relocation / Hybrid / Remote

Nationality: Indian

Business Transformation & Change Leadership

Value-Driven Delivery & Benefits Realisation

Governance, Risk & Assurance

Agile & Hybrid Execution

• Coordinate cross-functional teams, foster accountability, and enable high performance across business, operations, technology,
and partners.
